title: Fix the CLI --precision option so the requested decimal places are honored, and add regression tests. This is a small brownfield Python standard-library project

Project Information.Project: Fix the CLI --precision option so the requested decimal places are honored, and add regression tests. This is a small brownfield Python standard-library project. Current defect: python3 converter.py 1.2345 --precision 3 prints 1.23, expected 1.234. Keep default precision 2, accept 0 through 6, and preserve ValueError for out-of-range precision. Add unittest coverage for default, precision 0/3/6, negative values, invalid bounds, and the CLI. Keep unrelated files. No external packages, network services, deployment, or git commit/push is needed. Use a single work unit and keep documentation proportional to this small fix.
